dedupe_keys.name: sinae uruguay open data fire outbreaks recorded in the mira system and areas affected by forest fires

description: Uruguay's National Emergency System publishes two wildfire datasets on the national open data catalogue. The SINAE open data page read on 2026-09-28 loads its list by script and showed none, so the catalogue service was queried: it lists a point layer of fire outbreaks recorded in the MIRA risk and impact monitoring system, classed as field fires, native forest, planted forest and urban interface fires and sourced from departmental emergency coordination centres, the public security management system and the press, in shapefile, KML, CSV and XML; and a layer of areas affected by forest fires in shapefile, KML and XML. Both were last modified on 6 July 2022. Coverage is Uruguay. Access is free download under the Uruguayan open data licence. Caveats: the catalogue copies look unmaintained since 2022, and press-based records are incomplete. It supports wildfire exposure and emergency response studies, such as mapping urban interface fires near power lines and water plants. No related Uruguayan wildfire record is catalogued.
